name: 1D Aurora Borealis
concept: Soft aurora-coloured blobs (greens, turquoise, pink, violet) drift along the strip, breathe in and out over 15-30 s lives and occasionally reverse.
visual_verdict: Strip waterfall shows pleasant drifting teal/green curtains with gentle wavering; grid render just shows horizontal bands since it is index-only.
perf_smell: per-pixel loop over all waves with sqrt per wave per pixel; cheap at strip sizes but should be renderBulk + splat (or fillRange gradients) per blob
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec faithfully (dome envelope, sqrt-skewed age triangle, weighted palette presets); pink/purple rarely appear with the default greens preset.
action_notes: Keep as the strip aurora: convert to renderBulk with one splat per blob in add/max mode, give sliders real units (speed in strip-lengths/min, width in % of strip, waves as an integer count, palette as a 0..2 mode), and blend in OKLCH so overlaps glow rather than muddy. Consider folding into aurora-2d as its 1D path if aurora-2d already handles strips.

name: 1 White Fade
concept: The whole fixture breathes plain white on a ~33 s sine.
visual_verdict: Uniform white slowly ramping; nothing else happens.
perf_smell: none (should be renderBulk fill if kept)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the trivial spec exactly; the idea itself has no merit as a library entry.
action_notes: One 'Breathe' pattern (breathing-gradient as survivor) with a colour picker (default white), an optional second picker for a two-colour breathe, and a period-in-seconds slider covers 1-white-fade and 2-purple-fade; delete this file.

name: 2 Colors
concept: Static alternating blocks of two picker colours, block width 1..15 px.
visual_verdict: Static red/blue stripes; no motion at all.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with sensible default colours replacing the original's broken init.
action_notes: Static two-colour blocks are one setting of the block string-lights survivor (christmas-lights: up to 4 picker colours, block width in px, hold seconds, step/static mode); delete this file.

name: 2D canvas example
concept: Tutorial: a dot orbits a circle leaving a fading hue-cycling trail drawn into a 16x16 offscreen canvas and sampled per pixel.
visual_verdict: A thin, dim, broken-dotted ring with blotchy hues; the 16x16 bilinear sample makes the trail look speckled on 32x32.
perf_smell: two bilinear canvasGet per pixel for a single moving dot; renderBulk + fade + splat does this with no canvas at all
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the tutorial faithfully (canvasSet/canvasGet replaces manual indexing) but the idea is a code sample, not content.
action_notes: Teaching scaffolding; move the canvas idiom into docs/lang.md examples if wanted and drop it from the library.

name: 2d Clock with Hand Color Pickers
concept: Analog clock: hour/minute/second hands as hard coloured wedges from the centre, with ring/band/ray radius modes and a sharpness breathe.
technique: per-pixel polar math (atan2 + hypot + pow per pixel)
visual_verdict: Three fat aliased triangles (red/green/blue) on black, static across the sheet; reads as crude wedges rather than a clock face.
perf_smell: atan2 + hypot + up to three pow() per pixel
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: a clock face is better as a scene layer (a clock-hands sprite/drawLine layer over any ambient pattern)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec including all four radius modes; the spec's own result (hard thresholded wedges) is the problem.
action_notes: Make one analog clock pattern (rgbclock-2d survivor) drawn in renderBulk with three drawLine hands (antialiased capsules, tapered widths), tick marks, colour pickers and a 'face style' mode; drop the pow-threshold wedge approach and the 9 opaque 0..1 sliders.

name: 2D Fireworks Fade
concept: A real fireworks show: rockets with flickering trails rise, flash at apogee and break into six shell types (peony, willow, crackle, ring, comet, finale) with drag and droop, looping through types and colour schemes.
technique: particles deposited into an RGB canvas
visual_verdict: Clean black sky with rising amber rockets and crisp purple/gold bursts that droop and gutter; bursts look small but convincing on 32x32.
perf_smell: three RGB canvases with three bilinear canvasGet per pixel; canvas capped at 32x32 so a 64x64 panel is upscaled blur
cleanroom_quality: A deliberate ground-up redesign (fidelity waived); the result is far better than the original idea and the best 2D fireworks in the library.
action_notes: Make this THE 2D fireworks pattern (rename 'Fireworks'), absorb fireworks-finale's best shell types as modes, and move draw to renderBulk with fade() + splat(mode 1) per spark so it is native resolution on 64x64/128x128 and drops the 3 canvases.

name: 2D sinc(theta)/theta
concept: Three R/G/B ripple systems with 1/r sinc envelopes expand from wandering (often off-screen) centres and mix additively into a moire of secondaries and white.
visual_verdict: Bright, saturated, hypnotic additive rings in all primaries/secondaries; a little garish and white-blown, with one stray red speck at a centre singularity in frame 4.
perf_smell: 3x hypot + 3x cos + 3x pow per pixel (pow with integer exponent should be repeated multiply)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec well, including the dormant Size C repair; the singular-core clamp leaves an occasional hot speck.
action_notes: Keep as the flagship interference pattern and fold interference-2d in as a 'palette' mode (OKLCH or palette-mapped rings instead of pure RGB); replace pow with integer multiplies, guard d<epsilon, and rename to 'Sinc Ripples'.

name: 2D Spiral Twirls
concept: A rotating N-arm pinwheel whose arms periodically wind into a spiral, relax and wind the other way, each arm a half-rainbow comet ramp.
visual_verdict: Smooth green/teal two-arm swirl winding from pinwheel to spiral; pleasant but dim at the edges and only shows a narrow hue band at the default colour speed.
perf_smell: atan2 + hypot per pixel (fine; a polar lookup canvas would halve it on 16384 px)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec with the zero-freeze sliders fixed; the idea is sound.
action_notes: Survivor for the pinwheel/spiral family: absorb spiral-twirls-star-2d (star mode), rainbow-pinwheel, spinwheel-2d and spiral-2d as an 'arm profile' mode plus arm count; speed up the default colour drift so the rainbow actually shows.

name: 2D Wandering Fireball
concept: One soft hue-cycling ball wanders a Lissajous path over a dim wash of the same hue.
visual_verdict: A single fuzzy orange/yellow blob drifting with a visible plus-shaped hot-core artifact; mostly black panel; underwhelming.
perf_smell: none (per-pixel separable product; renderBulk fill + splat would be cheaper)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to a thin spec; the diamond profile and core threshold produce the plus artifact.
action_notes: A single wandering blob is not library-worthy; metaballs-of-fire-2d and the bouncing-balls survivor cover the look. If kept at all, become a 'count=1' preset of the metaballs pattern.

name: 2 Purple Fade
concept: Whole fixture breathes one fixed violet on a ~30 s sine.
visual_verdict: Uniform violet ramping slowly; nothing else.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; hard-coded hue with no picker makes it strictly worse than its siblings.
action_notes: Delete; the Breathe survivor's colour picker with a violet preset covers it.

name: 3 color rotation
concept: Hard-edged cyan/magenta/gold segments that step one segment along the strip every half second.
visual_verdict: Static-looking checkerboard of three flat colours that jumps a segment each beat; no easing, no glow.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Fixes both spec defects (unreachable colour, frame-count timing); the idea is a bare segment chase.
action_notes: Fold into one 'Segment Chase' pattern (marquee-chase survivor) with up to 4 picker colours, segment width in px, step time in seconds and a smooth/step toggle; delete this file.

name: 3D Rotation / Spotlights
concept: A double-cone SDF tumbles on a wandering axis; on a cube it reads as two crimson spotlight discs with white-hot centres sweeping the faces.
technique: per-pixel 3D SDF with per-frame rotation matrix
visual_verdict: On the 2D slice it is a crimson bow-tie/beam spinning and tumbling, with soft rims; single-hue but dynamic.
perf_smell: sqrt per pixel (fine)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec; same original idea as spotlights-rotation-3d, which adds a hue-by-x variant and sliders.
action_notes: The two files are two ports of the same double-cone idea; keep spotlights-rotation-3d, add a 'Colour' mode (fixed crimson picker vs hue-by-x) and cone-width/speed sliders in real units; delete this file.

name: 4th
concept: Fourth-of-July strip: dim red/white/blue bunting drifts while orange rockets streak, stall and crackle into red/white/blue bursts.
visual_verdict: Index-order render on the grid shows dim diagonal bunting with orange streaks and sparse coloured crackle; plausibly festive on a strip, bunting a bit muddy.
perf_smell: 4x array(pixelCount) (trail + 3 spark channels) and a per-pixel interpreted loop with random() per pixel in renderBulk
cleanroom_quality: Deliberate fork that fixes the original's washed-out crackle; idea is delivered and better than the original.
action_notes: Rename to 'Fourth of July' and make it the strip holiday-fireworks entry; replace the 4 pixel buffers with persistent-frame renderBulk (fade() + fillRange bunting underlay re-laid via a dedicated low layer, setPixel sparks) or accept 2 buffers; consider a holiday-palette mode shared with the strip fireworks survivor.

name: 80s kid show
concept: Retro screensaver: flat poster-coloured circles, squares, triangles, hexagons and stars drift, bounce, spin and breathe, with occasional z-order swaps.
technique: per-pixel SDF over an object pool
visual_verdict: Bold flat mint/red/green/magenta/blue shapes overlapping and tumbling; fun retro look, aliased edges at 32x32, colours a little random (mint dominates).
perf_smell: per-pixel loop over up to 18 objects with SDF + hypot each (bbox reject helps); 0.9 ms/frame is the heaviest so far
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec (SDF shapes, swaps, breathe, flat/glow) and fixes the swap flicker; the default palette spacing (+0.45 hue) clusters colours.
action_notes: Keep: convert the 0..1 sliders to real units (count, size in % of panel, speed in panels/s), use a fixed 80s poster palette (Memphis: teal, hot pink, yellow, purple) instead of hue+0.45 steps, add 1-px dark outline for that cartoon read, and antialias the SDF edge.

name: Accelerometer level example
concept: Tutorial spirit level: a rainbow bar through the centre counter-rotates against accelerometer tilt.
visual_verdict: A static horizontal rainbow bar across the middle on every frame (no sensor input).
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful tutorial port; without a sensor board it is a static bar.
action_notes: Teaching scaffolding for a sensor almost no one has; keep the transform+accelerometer snippet in docs/lang.md instead. If a tilt pattern is wanted, make one sensor showcase (e.g. a tilt-driven liquid/sand surface) rather than this.

name: All Lasers Fire
concept: Laser volleys from a bottom corner morph between ordered grids and chaotic spray via tangent poles, with RGB chromatic-aberration fringes.
visual_verdict: Mostly black frames with a white blob in the bottom-left corner; one frame shows a nice rainbow-fringed beam and one shows scattered RGB specks - the volley is rarely on screen.
perf_smell: 3x tan + 3x hypot + 6x frac + 3x divide per pixel
cleanroom_quality: Mechanically follows the spec, but the field spends most of each cycle collapsed to a corner glow, so the 'volley' payoff barely shows on a 32x32 grid.
action_notes: Keep the idea (chromatic-fringed laser fan from an edge) but build it explicitly: N beams as drawLine capsules from a moving emitter in renderBulk with mode-1 additive RGB offsets for the fringe, volley/rest rhythm in seconds; drop the tan-pole field that is dark 80% of the time.

name: amoeba
concept: Fuzzy blue blobs drift both ways over a dim purple strip while short dark dimples blink at random spots.
visual_verdict: Purple background with soft blue blobs drifting diagonally in the waterfall, peppered with many black dash-like dimples that read as dropouts rather than texture.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) cleared with an interpreted loop each frame, sin() per covered pixel per particle
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the declared design (fixes the generated-code slot bugs); the dimple layer is what makes it look broken.
action_notes: Keep the 'two-way drifting blobs on a tinted ground' idea as a small renderBulk pattern (fillGradient/fill ground + splat per blob in max mode on a 1D map), drop or soften dimples into brief brightness dips, add two colour pickers and a blob-count/speed control in real units; zero fields with feedback(arr,0) if buffers stay.

name: angle and radius from coordinates
concept: Teaching pattern: a thin radar spoke sweeps around the map centre with hue by 3D radius; on 3D maps the rate grows with height, twisting into a helix.
visual_verdict: A thin rainbow spoke (red at centre, blue at edge) sweeping around a black panel; clean but sparse.
perf_smell: atan2 + hypot3 per pixel (fine)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with sliders added in real units; it is a teaching aid that happens to render a radar sweep.
action_notes: Fold the 3D height-twist and radius-hue as options into radar-2d (a 'hue by radius' toggle and z-twist for 3D maps); delete this teaching file.

name: Angry Xmass 3D
concept: Hard red/green bands with racing white streaks whose axis is re-picked at random every frame - a deliberate violent strobe.
visual_verdict: Every frame is a different random arrangement of red/green/grey slabs and a stray grey panel - pure flicker, no readable motion.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to an idea that is an epilepsy hazard by design.
action_notes: Per-frame random strobe is not shippable; the red/green holiday family has better members.

name: Animated Asterisks 2D
concept: N full-span bars through the centre, fanned over a half-turn, rotating together in an evenly spaced drifting rainbow.
technique: per-pixel segment distance over N arms
visual_verdict: Four thick flat bars (red, cyan, green, purple) crossing at the centre; the sheet looks nearly frozen because rotation and hue steps alias at 1 s sampling - reads like a static asterisk icon.
perf_smell: per-pixel loop over all arms; the author notes it already strobes at ~8 fps on 64x64
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with real-unit controls; the spec's width-breathing animation was dropped, removing what little motion variety it had.
action_notes: An asterisk is a few drawLine calls: make it a 'rotating spokes' mode of a renderBulk line pattern (line-dancer-2d survivor) using drawLine mode 1 so crossings glow additively instead of first-hit occlusion; restores the width breathe and removes the aliasing-driven speed cap.

name: A Peak Integrator
concept: Beat-detection engine with a debug meter: 8 fixed 18-px segments flash and drain when a peak is detected.
visual_verdict: Mostly dark; beats paint dim red-to-green bars that drain in a few frames, plus a stuck green tail block - looks like a debug readout.
perf_smell: none (cheap), but hard-coded 144-px meter ignores pixelCount
cleanroom_quality: Cleans up the detector but deliberately keeps the original's debug-style shared meter and per-pixel drain quirk; the idea (a beat detector) is engine, not content.
action_notes: Delete as library content. If the beat detector is good, lift it into a shared engine/prelude beat helper (or the sensor board's beat output) that the sound survivors can call.

name: Audio Volume Meter
concept: Five- or three-section VU meter (bass at both ends, fills inward/outward) with EQ sliders, PI auto-gain and triple smoothing.
visual_verdict: Clean rainbow-shifting bars in five sections that pump with the synthetic music; legible and lively on a strip.
perf_smell: 5x array(pixelCount) (sec5, frac5, sec3, frac3, prevV) for what is five fillRange calls per frame
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec including the auto-gain loop; the colour slider is a quantized 0..1 preset picker and most sliders are unitless 0..1.
action_notes: Keep as the strip VU meter: renderBulk with one fillRange (or fillGradient) per section and a small per-section smoothed level instead of per-pixel tables and prevV; replace the colour slider with a mode selector (cycle/rainbow/picker) and give EQ sliders dB units.

name: Aurora 2D
concept: Aurora curtains: a simplex-noise band waves across the panel with vertical simplex shimmer rays, painted black to green to violet.
visual_verdict: Waving green curtain with violet hot spots across the middle third; organic and convincing, though the top and bottom thirds stay black and the violet reads as blobs rather than curtain tips.
perf_smell: interpreted per-cell loop with paint()+setPixel (documented as the only byte-exact option); fine
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Survivor of the aurora family: let the band height/thickness vary with a second noise octave so curtains fill more of the panel, push violet to the curtain tops (palette by height not just brightness), add a speed slider in seconds and a palette mode; trim the essay-length header comment to a few lines.

name: aurorashivers
concept: Violet and aqua triangular blobs bloom and drift in opposite directions with a per-frame shiver, leaving a pure-blue running-max afterglow.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows crisp diagonal blue streaks with soft blue afterglow trails; attractive but almost monochrome blue (violet/aqua tints barely register).
perf_smell: 3x array(pixelCount) with an interpreted clear loop and an interpreted afterglow max loop every frame
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the declarative-compositor spec; the afterglow trick is delivered.
action_notes: Fold the drifting-blob + afterglow look into the strip aurora survivor as a 'shiver' style (renderBulk: fade() gives the afterglow for free, splat/fillRange per blob in max mode), with stronger violet/aqua separation; delete this file.

name: Autumn Colors
concept: Per-pixel twinkles that fade out over seconds and pop back in weighted red/brown/orange/yellow.
visual_verdict: Dense warm red/orange vertical streaks in the waterfall (each pixel fading); pleasant autumn shimmer, a bit busy and dark-heavy.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) updated by an interpreted loop every tick
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with sensible hue shift/range/fade sliders in real units.
action_notes: An 'autumn' palette preset of the pop-and-fade survivor (chill-confetti) with palette modes (drift / autumn / spring / halloween / holiday / pickers) and fade seconds; covers spring-colors, halloween-color-twinkles and christmas-rg-fade too.

name: Beat Bounce
concept: Tempo-locked scanner: a hot ember core sweeps every four beats and swells with a violet halo on each beat, set by a BPM input.
technique: per-pixel math with beatSin/beat and OKLab mixColors
visual_verdict: Clean orange sine-sweep with a faint violet halo at the turns in the waterfall; tidy but just a single dot.
perf_smell: mixColors (OKLab) per pixel: 0.62 ms on 1024 px for one dot
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Give the scanner survivor a BPM-lock option (beatSin sweep + beat thump width) and drop this file; if kept, renderBulk with two splats (core + halo) instead of per-pixel mixColors.

name: Bessel Chaos
concept: Cubic/quartic spatial chirps inside sines around a wandering focal point: broad breathing cyan blobs at the focus exploding into fine chaotic ripples away from it.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows blue/cyan ripples compressing into fine aliased stipple away from a drifting focus; genuinely unusual, but on 60 px the far field is pixel noise and it is almost monochrome blue.
perf_smell: none (two sin per pixel)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the slider keeps a 0..1-era mapping (1 + v*14) on a 1..15 range, so the declared bounds and handler disagree.
action_notes: Fix the transition slider (bounds say 1..15 but the handler rescales as if 0..1, giving up to 211), clamp the chirp so the far field does not alias into noise on short strips, and add a hue/palette picker; give it a 2D radial mode (chirp of radius) where it would shine on a panel.

name: b_lightning_flashes
concept: A dark strip where short segments flash like lightning, crackle at peak and die, then a random pause.
visual_verdict: Sparse short grey-white smears with tiny blue cores on black; reads as dim static flashes, not lightning.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, including the inverted white-fringe/blue-core look, which is the weak part.
action_notes: Fold into one 'Lightning' pattern with a strip mode (branching multi-flash strikes with afterglow, real flash/gap seconds) and a 2D cloud mode; delete this file.

name: Blink Fade
concept: Classic twinkle: each pixel ignites at a random brightness in a drifting narrow rainbow band, fades and re-ignites.
visual_verdict: Waterfall is dense rapid rainbow confetti noise - fades last only ~0.1 s at the default speed, so it reads as flicker rather than gentle twinkle.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) + interpreted per-pixel update loop each frame
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Merge the pop-and-fade family (blink-fade, quiet-blinkfade, sound-blinkfade's visual) into chill-confetti: fade time in seconds (default ~2 s - the current default fades in ~0.1 s), density, hue drift/spread, optional sound-reactive toggle; read out with fillHSV in renderBulk.

name: Blinky Eyes 2D
concept: A pair of cartoon eyes: white elliptical outlines with blue ring irises that dart side to side, plus randomized blinks.
technique: per-pixel ellipse/iris math with gaze+blink state machines
visual_verdict: Two small grey-outlined eyes with blue irises in a thin strip across the panel middle; blinks visible (two frames with empty eyes); charming but tiny - two thirds of the panel is black.
perf_smell: two hypot per pixel (fine)
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: the eye shapes are static art; a scene of an eye sprite pair with scripted iris/lid layers would be cleaner once scripted layer positioning exists
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with the lid-line fix and real-unit controls; geometry tuned for 20x10 leaves a square panel mostly empty.
action_notes: Fill the panel: size eyes by panel height too (default ~70% tall), add a white sclera fill option, pupil + specular highlight, eyelid that sweeps down rather than squashing, and look up/down as well as sideways; consider re-expressing as a scene when scripted sprite positioning lands.

name: block reflections
concept: Mirror-symmetric chunky colour blocks fold out from the strip centre, zooming in and out with hue slices and travelling dark seams.
visual_verdict: Busy, saturated rainbow chevrons and sawtooth blocks with hard seams; mirror symmetry is visible but it reads garish and jittery.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec; the spec's hard frac() seams are what make it harsh.
action_notes: Keep the mirror-fold idea but tame it: palette or OKLCH hue window instead of full-saturation HSV, smoothstep seams instead of frac wrap, and a slower default; otherwise a delete candidate if the library already has enough mirror/kaleido strips.

name: Blue Holiday Candle 2D
concept: A stylized candle: blue-cored flame with orange rim sways, breathes and gutters above a blue body, with three warm stars twinkling in a dim purple sky.
technique: per-pixel analytic shapes (sqrt + several sin per pixel)
visual_verdict: Reads as an orange ring around a blue egg sitting on a blue gradient - more like an eye or a gem than a flame; the sway is visible but the silhouette never looks like fire.
perf_smell: sqrt + 3 sin + triangle per pixel plus a star-match loop per background pixel; 0.62 ms/frame
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: candle body + sky is a static backdrop (sprite/wash layer) with an animated flame layer on top - a natural scene
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the annulus-around-a-blob construction in the spec, plus added breathing/guttering; the construction itself does not read as a flame.
action_notes: Rebuild the flame as a teardrop SDF (narrow tip, round base) with a noise-displaced edge and a palette from white-blue core through blue to a thin orange tip, candle body as a wax-coloured rectangle with a wick; ship as a scene (backdrop sprite + flame pattern + twinkle layer) so a colour picker re-themes it.

name: Blue Holiday Star 2D
concept: An icy cyan eight-pointed star from two Minkowski p-norm stars, noise-twinkling and rotating imperceptibly.
technique: per-pixel Minkowski distance (4-6 pow per pixel)
visual_verdict: A single 2-3 pixel cyan dot in the centre of a black panel on every frame - the rays never reach a visible size at 32x32; effectively broken.
perf_smell: six pow() per pixel to draw a dot
cleanroom_quality: Follows the spec's constants, but the size/exponent choice leaves the star sub-pixel on real panels; carrie-s-holiday-star-2d is the same idea and actually shows rays.
action_notes: Same Minkowski-star idea as Carrie's; delete this file and give the survivor a colour picker (icy blue preset) instead.

name: Carrie's Holiday Star 2D
concept: An eight-pointed Minkowski p-norm star that twinkles via simplex noise, rotates slowly and drifts hue over minutes.
technique: per-pixel Minkowski distance (4 pow per pixel)
visual_verdict: A small cyan four/eight-point twinkle in the centre with thin rays, pulsing in size; pretty but occupies ~15% of the panel and the rest is black.
perf_smell: four pow() per pixel (axis-star exponent is constant and could be a lookup); 0.56 ms/frame
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: a holiday star is a natural scene layer (star pattern over a twinkling night sky or a tree sprite)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec (Minkowski star, noise twinkle, slow spin, hue drift).
action_notes: Survivor for the holiday-star pair: scale ray reach with a 'size' control in % of panel (default much larger), add a colour picker / hue-drift toggle, a faint background star twinkle, and replace the constant-exponent pow pair with a cheaper ray falloff; offer it as a scene layer for tree toppers.

name: Boids 2D
concept: Six flocking boids (cohesion, alignment, separation, simplex wander) leave fading trails on a 16x16 canvas.
visual_verdict: A handful of blocky 2x2 pixels in pastel colours scattered on black; the flock and trails barely read at 16x16 upsampled to 32x32.
perf_smell: none (cheap), but the fixed 16x16 canvas wastes a 64x64 panel
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Make it a real flock: 20-40 boids, renderBulk with fade() trails and splat/drawLine per boid (velocity-oriented streak) at native resolution, hue by heading, controls for count, speed, trail seconds and separation; this could be a showcase on 64x64.

name: 2D Bouncing Additive Primaries
concept: Soft red, green and blue disks ricochet off the walls and mix additively into secondaries and white; extra disks get distinct hues.
visual_verdict: Big soft R/G/B glows bouncing with cyan/yellow/magenta overlaps; pleasant but the same picture as several sibling patterns.
perf_smell: dist() per disk per pixel (N hypot per pixel); clear()+splat(mode 1) per disk does it per ball
cleanroom_quality: Faithful (delta-scaled motion, stratified start), with a sensible extension to 12 hued disks.
action_notes: The 2D bouncing-ball family collapses into bulk-bouncing-balls-2d (renderBulk + splat mode 1): add a 'Palette' mode (rainbow / additive primaries) and a 'Motion' mode (billiard / gravity / Lissajous drift) plus breathing radius; delete this file.

name: Bouncer3D
concept: Colored balls bounce in the unit square/cube with white-hot centres and Manhattan-distance falloff.
technique: per-pixel box test over N balls
visual_verdict: Tiny plus-shaped coloured sparkles scattered on black - reads as confetti, not balls.
perf_smell: per-pixel loop over balls (box reject keeps it cheap)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, including the same-corner velocity quirk and the speed-slider reshuffle side effect, both of which a library pattern should not keep.
action_notes: Its only distinct value is a render3D path; give the bouncing-balls survivor a 3D mode (balls in the unit cube, splat in 3D or a per-pixel render3D fallback) and delete this file.

name: Bouncing Balls 2D
concept: One white ball per column bouncing under real gravity with an optional rainbow column beneath it; shake or auto-relaunch restarts.
visual_verdict: Starts as a full rainbow wall that collapses into lower and lower rippling rainbow columns topped with white balls, then settles near the floor - striking for the first seconds, then mostly black.
perf_smell: hard-coded 16 columns on a 16x16 canvas regardless of panel size
cleanroom_quality: Faithful (auto-relaunch enabled); keeps the spec's hard-coded width of 16, the spec's own flagged defect.
action_notes: Rename 'Bouncing Columns'; derive columns from gridWidth() and draw in renderBulk with fillRect/gridIndex per column, give the sliders real units (gravity in panel-heights/s^2, stagger seconds), and relaunch balls individually so the panel never settles to black.

name: bouncing balls - hsv
concept: Eight single-pixel rainbow balls bounce under gravity along a strip with slightly different restitution, drifting from sync into chaos.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows clean parabolic arcs; balls start overlapped (one magenta dominates) and only spread into a rainbow after many bounces.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) to place 8 pixels
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; direction mode and ball count are source constants with no controls.
action_notes: bouncing-balls-rgb already does the same thing with controls, direction modes and additive overlap; delete this file.

name: Bouncing Balls RGB 2D
concept: Panel reading of the strip gravity balls: rainbow glows fall, bounce with decreasing restitution, drift sideways and add where they overlap.
visual_verdict: Bright saturated rainbow glows bunched along the floor with white overlaps; lively, though balls spend most time in the bottom third.
perf_smell: hypot per ball per pixel (box reject helps); 0.45 ms/frame - should be splat mode 1
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Becomes the 'gravity' motion mode of the bouncing-balls survivor (renderBulk + splat mode 1 + optional drawLine tail); delete this file.

name: bouncing balls - rgb
concept: Single-pixel rainbow balls fall under gravity onto one end and bounce, desynchronizing, with additive RGB overlap and four direction modes.
visual_verdict: Grid (index-order) render shows sparse single coloured pixels; on a strip it is the classic bouncing-dots effect - correct but thin (1 px balls, no trails).
perf_smell: 3x array(pixelCount) accumulators to place 8 pixels; setPixel per ball after clear() would need none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful with good real-unit controls and the direction fold moved to deposit time.
action_notes: Survivor of the strip gravity-balls pair: drop the three buffers for clear()/fade() + setPixel (or splat on a 1D map) with a short motion trail option and ball width in px; absorb bouncing-balls-hsv.

name: Bouncing RGB Balls - 2D
concept: Three large soft R/G/B discs glide on independent Lissajous waves and breathe their radius, mixing additively.
visual_verdict: Large soft red/green/blue blobs with cyan/yellow overlaps filling most of the panel; calm and pretty.
perf_smell: 3 hypot per pixel; splat x3 would be cheaper
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; no controls exposed.
action_notes: Becomes the 'Lissajous drift' motion mode + 'additive primaries' palette + breathing size option of the bouncing-balls survivor; delete this file.

name: Bulk Bouncing Balls 2D
concept: Rainbow balls bounce off the walls drawn as additive splats with drawLine motion-blur tails - the renderBulk entity-loop showcase.
visual_verdict: Crisp small glowing rainbow balls with short tails bouncing around; clean but small and sparse at the defaults.
perf_smell: none (the reference cheap approach, 0.027 ms/frame)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Survivor and rename to 'Bouncing Balls': add Motion mode (billiard / gravity with restitution spread / Lissajous drift), Palette mode (rainbow / additive primaries / picker), breathing radius, optional fade() trails and a render3D path, absorbing the four siblings; drop 'Bulk' from the name.

name: Bouncy Boxes
concept: Four solid rainbow squares glide over a cylinder, wrapping horizontally, bouncing vertically and colliding elastically, each with a radial hue gradient.
technique: rigid-body sim into a 16x16 canvas + fillCanvas
visual_verdict: Crisp little squares with concentric rainbow rings sliding and colliding; tidy and readable, though small on 32x32 and a few frames show thin slivers where boxes wrap.
perf_smell: per-cell x per-box interpreted canvas paint (16x16x4) - fine; fixed 16x16 canvas is blocky on 64x64
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec's physics and look; sensibly drops the tearing bands. Sparkle sliders are bare 0..1.
action_notes: Draw the boxes directly with fillRect in renderBulk at native resolution (keep the 16-unit sim space), add box count/size/speed controls in real units, and either fold the glitch sparkle into a proper toggle or delete it.

name: Breakout 2D
concept: Self-playing Breakout: rainbow brick wall, white ball, auto-tracking paddle, fixed 100 ms game ticks.
visual_verdict: Instantly readable Breakout: rainbow brick rows with holes knocked out, a glowing ball and paddle; fun on a panel.
perf_smell: none, but hard-coded 16x16 so a 64x64 panel shows 4x4-pixel bricks and ball
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec; still assumes a 16x16 board as the spec warned.
action_notes: Size the board from gridWidth()/gridHeight() (or a 'board size' control), draw in renderBulk with fillRect per brick, add brick-break particles and a ball trail, real-unit paddle width in cells and game speed in ticks/s; make the paddle-position slider meaningful only when demo is off.

name: Breathing Gradient
concept: Two slowly drifting hues blended along the strip in OKLab with an eased breathing dim and gamma 2.2.
visual_verdict: Smooth orange-green-cyan gradient that breathes; looks good bright but spends about a third of the cycle near-black because of the 0.15 floor under gamma 2.2.
perf_smell: mixColors per pixel (0.58 ms on 1024 px); fillGradient or a 2-stop palette would be one call
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Survivor 'Breathe': controls for breath period (s), floor (%), drift on/off, two colour pickers or a complement/triad pair mode (absorbs 1-white-fade, 2-purple-fade, complements-3d), axis option on 2D/3D maps; raise the floor so it never goes black, and render with renderBulk + fillGradient (or fillRGB from a small OKLab LUT built per frame) instead of per-pixel mixColors.

name: Bubble Column
concept: A dim fluid-filled tube with bright milky bubbles rising and accelerating, released in noise-gated bursts.
technique: particles into a per-pixel buffer + perlin per pixel
visual_verdict: Mostly dark navy strip with thin fast lavender streaks; bubbles are 1-2 px blips that cross quickly - the aquarium feel is weak.
perf_smell: pixelCount x bubbles loop in beforeRender, perlin() per pixel in render, array(pixelCount) buffer
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the 3-px radius with ^4 falloff makes bubbles tiny and the fluid at 6% brightness reads as off.
action_notes: renderBulk: fillGradient/fill the fluid (a cheap 1D simplex wobble per frame via a 16-sample LUT), splat each bubble (1D map) with a size in px and wobble; raise fluid brightness, slow the base speed, add bubble-size and rate controls in real units.

name: Bulk Canvas Ripples 2D
concept: A 16x16 wave-equation pond integrated with bulk array builtins and shown with one fillCanvas; raindrops spawn rings.
visual_verdict: First frame shows a clean ring, then a blocky, noisy blue/teal checker of interfering waves; nearest-sampled 16x16 cells read as chunky mush on 32x32.
perf_smell: none (0.05 ms), but a 16x16 nearest-sampled canvas is visibly blocky on any real panel
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Its bulk-array wave sim is the right engine for the ripple survivor: move it into raindrops-2d (or ripples-2d) at 32x32 with canvasGet/bilinear or paintCanvas upsampling, a water palette and injected-event drops; drop 'Bulk' from the library name.

name: Bulk Comet Trails
concept: Three rainbow comets bounce along the strip with fade() trails and no buffers - the persistent-frame showcase.
visual_verdict: On the grid (index order) it is scattered coloured specks; on a strip it would be three bouncing comets with trails - correct but plain.
perf_smell: none (0.003 ms - the reference approach)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: This is the cheapest correct comet engine: make it the implementation of the comet/scanner survivor (comet count, speed, trail seconds, palette) and delete the 'Bulk' teaching name.

name: Bulk Rainbow
concept: A scrolling rainbow painted with one fillGradient call per frame.
visual_verdict: Smooth scrolling full rainbow bands; exactly the stock rainbow.
perf_smell: none (the reference approach)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Make rainbow.js this implementation (fillGradient, speed + cycles, plus rainbow-v2's direction/saturation and a 2D axis option) and delete bulk-rainbow and rainbow-v2.

name: Bulk Sprite Scroll 2D
concept: An 8x8 yellow smiley sprite built in code scrolls across a dim two-tone wash via keyed blit().
visual_verdict: A small yellow pixel smiley drifting right-to-left with a slight bob over a near-black green wash.
perf_smell: none
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: this is literally a sprite over a wash - it should be a library sprite plus a scene layer with a scroll ramp
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Move the face into library/sprites (or reuse rainbow-smiley's) and ship a 'Sprite Parade' example scene (wash layer + scrolling sprite layer); delete the pattern. Doubles as the motivating case for scripted layer positioning (the bob).

name: bustle
concept: Two-way comet traffic: fast magenta and slower crimson pulses launch from both ends at jittered intervals and speeds, crossings occlude by max.
visual_verdict: Waterfall is a lively lattice of red and magenta streaks crossing at varied slopes; reads as busy traffic and looks good on a strip.
perf_smell: 4x array(pixelCount) buffers cleared and rasterized every frame
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with per-pulse speed spread improving on the regular lattice.
action_notes: Keep as the two-way traffic strip (consider absorbing traffic.js as a palette mode): renderBulk with clear() + one gradient fillRange-style draw per pulse in max blend, no buffers; add two colour pickers, density and speed controls in real units.

name: Butterfly 2D
concept: A drawn butterfly with petal-lobe wings, margin band and eyespots flaps by anisotropic scaling, rises in, flutters harder and lifts off; each new one gets a fresh hue and tilt.
technique: per-pixel polar SDF (atan2, exp x2, several sqrt)
visual_verdict: A clear, charming orange butterfly with pale margins, purple eyespots, dark body and antennae, visibly flapping and flying off the top in the last frame - one of the best-reading figures in the range.
perf_smell: atan2 + 2 exp + 5 sqrt/dist per pixel with no bounding-box reject: 1.15 ms/frame, heaviest in this range
cleanroom_quality: Diverges from the spec (no harmonic-sum + noise wing shapes, no per-butterfly shape variety) in favour of a fixed, legible silhouette - the right call at LED resolution; variety now comes only from hue and tilt.
action_notes: Add a bounding-box early-out (most pixels are background) and precompute the per-frame lobe constants; restore some per-butterfly variety (wing proportions/lobe angles randomized within legible bounds), optionally several butterflies at once on 64x64.

name: Cellular Automata 1D
concept: An elementary Wolfram cellular automaton stepping ~10 generations/s on the strip, coloured by cell age or rule case, auto-reseeding.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows a crisp red Sierpinski triangle (rule 90) - but that structure only exists over time; live on a strip it is a row of flickering red dots, and age colouring stays one flat red for rule 90.
perf_smell: 3x array(pixelCount) and an interpreted per-cell step loop (fine at 10 Hz)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; all six sliders are bare 0..1 (rule as 0..1 with step 0.004 is unusable).
action_notes: Make it shine on a panel: render the generation history as a scrolling 2D waterfall (row = generation, via a canvas + fillCanvas/blit) with the 1D strip as a fallback; rule as an integer 0..255 input with a curated-rules mode (30, 90, 110, 184), palette by generation instead of age.

name: Chasing Rainbows & HSLuv
concept: A scrolling rainbow with six position-to-colour mappings (HSV, warps, 9-stop tables, HSLuv) for comparing perceptual evenness on LEDs.
visual_verdict: A dimmed (65%) plain HSV rainbow scrolling slowly - the default mode is just a darker rainbow.
perf_smell: 3x array(pixelCount) HSLuv cache rebuilt 10x/s with a big per-pixel fixed-point conversion
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, including a full HSLuv port; but the engine already has oklch(), which makes the HSLuv machinery redundant.
action_notes: A colour-space comparison tool is not library content; give the rainbow survivor a 'colour space' mode (HSV / OKLCH perceptual) and delete this file with its HSLuv port.

name: Chevron 2D
concept: One-line render2D: abs() folds a scrolling rainbow into a V chevron (QMK keyboard classic).
visual_verdict: Bold full-saturation rainbow chevrons scrolling sideways; vivid and clean but a one-trick gradient.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Make 'shape' a mode of the rainbow survivor (linear / chevron / radial / spiral on 2D maps) with speed, angle and width controls; delete this one-liner.

name: chill confetti
concept: Gentle confetti: random pixels pop in a tight hue family around a drifting base hue and fade exponentially over a second or two.
visual_verdict: Sparse, dim cyan-to-violet specks on a mostly black panel; on a strip it is a calm sprinkle, on a 32x32 grid it reads as nearly empty.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) (acceptable; read-out is already one fillHSV)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with clean real-unit controls and a bulk read-out.
action_notes: Survivor of the random pop-and-fade family: scale spawn rate with pixelCount (sparks per second per 100 px) so panels are not empty, add a palette mode (drift / autumn / spring / holiday / picker) and sparkle-on-white option, absorbing blink-fade, quiet-blinkfade and autumn-colors.

name: Christmas Candy Cane
concept: Red/white candy-cane stripes crawling along the strip like a conveyor belt.
visual_verdict: Clean dark-red and white diagonal stripes in the waterfall (a steady crawl); the red at half brightness looks maroon next to full white.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with stripes/speed/hue/width controls in real units; keeps the spec's dim-red asymmetry.
action_notes: Survivor 'Candy Stripes': two colour pickers (default red/white at matched perceived brightness), soft antialiased edges, a 2D diagonal mode absorbing holiday-diagonal-stripes; renderBulk is unnecessary but a fillRange-per-stripe version would be trivial.

name: Christmas Lights
concept: String-light blocks repeating red / dim white / green that rotate one block position every few seconds, with optional dark gaps between bulbs.
visual_verdict: Flat red/grey/green bars that jump once in the 8 s sheet; static, utilitarian.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, fixes the uninitialized-roles bug, adds bulb gap.
action_notes: Survivor of the block string-lights family: up to 4 colour pickers, bulb size/gap in px, transition mode (step / crossfade / stretch-slide from christmasstretch / static), hold seconds; absorbs christmaslights, christmasstretch, static-christmas-lights-4-colors and 2-colors. Add a per-bulb soft falloff so blocks read as bulbs.

name: ChristmasLights
concept: Fixed 20-px blocks cycling red / green / soft white, all stepping to the next look every two seconds.
visual_verdict: Three huge flat blocks (red, green, grey) that swap colour every 2 s - a test card, not lights.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful (and correctly reports red/green, not the comment's red/blue).
action_notes: Same idea as christmas-lights with a bigger default block; delete.

name: ChristmasPewPew
concept: Red and green laser volleys fly down the strip at mixed speeds with fading tails over a faint red underglow.
technique: particles into RGB trail buffers + fillRGB
visual_verdict: In index order on 1024 px the trails saturate into a muddy green/olive/red wash; on a 60-150 px strip it would read as red/green streaks.
perf_smell: 3x array(pixelCount) (two trails + a constant underglow array) where fade() + setPixel needs none; decay is per frame, not per second
cleanroom_quality: Faithful re-skin; decay remains frame-rate dependent and there are no controls.
action_notes: A holiday palette preset of the laser-volley survivor (pew-pew-pew) using renderBulk fade() trails and an underglow fill; delete this file.

name: Christmas RG Fade
concept: Every pixel independently glows red or green, fades over seconds and relights with a coin-flip colour.
visual_verdict: Dense red/green vertical fade streaks in the waterfall - a busy shimmer, quite dark overall.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) + interpreted per-pixel loop each frame
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; no controls.
action_notes: A 'holiday red/green' palette preset of the pop-and-fade survivor; delete this file.

name: ChristmasStretch
concept: Red, green and dim-white bands creep along the strip; each 2 s cycle the first band shrinks and the last widens, then colours rotate.
visual_verdict: Sawtooth-edged red/green/grey bands sliding in the waterfall with a visible hitch at each 2 s wrap.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; no controls.
action_notes: Becomes the 'stretch slide' transition mode of the christmas-lights survivor; delete.

name: color bands (buffered)
concept: Technique demo: the color-bands moire (rainbow ramp seen through drifting interfering bright bands with white spots) computed into buffers and read out with fillHSV.
visual_verdict: In index order on the grid it is dense high-frequency rainbow speckle; on a strip it is the same look as color-bands with narrower bands.
perf_smell: 3x array(pixelCount) filled by an interpreted loop with 4 wave() per pixel - slower than the unbuffered sibling
cleanroom_quality: Faithful (brightness fix noted); its whole reason to exist (a buffering technique demo) is moot under renderBulk.
action_notes: Same visual as color-bands with different wave periods; delete and let color-bands carry a band-width control.

name: color bands
concept: A double rainbow along the strip seen through a slowly shifting moire mask of short bright bands with brief white spots.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows thin saturated rainbow bars with black gaps and white glints, drifting very slowly - nearly static over 8 s; reads like a barcode.
perf_smell: none (4 wave() per pixel)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful with real-unit controls.
action_notes: Survivor of the pair; speed the default drift so the moire visibly crawls, and offer the band mask over a palette (not only the HSV rainbow). Low priority - a deletion candidate if the strip library is over-full of rainbow-moire patterns.

name: Color Blend
concept: Three smooth R/G/B waves drift along the strip at independent signed speeds and mix additively into shifting blends.
visual_verdict: Regular stripes of yellow/blue/white/red bands that barely move over 8 s; calm but monotonous at the default spread of ~10 wavelengths.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, including the reciprocal centre-stopped speed sliders, which are bare 0..1.
action_notes: Give speeds real units (wavelengths/s, signed, -2..2), spread as wavelengths across the strip, default fewer/wider waves; consider a 2D mode where the three waves travel at different angles (much more interesting on a panel).

name: color fade pulse
concept: A fast-scrolling rainbow seen through a few narrow drifting brightness peaks, with saturation washing toward white and back.
visual_verdict: Thin dim diagonal streaks in the waterfall with rainbow fringes inside each pulse and greyish washed segments; capped at half brightness so it looks murky.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful including the 0.5 brightness cap the spec describes.
action_notes: One 'Pulse Train' pattern (color-pick-fade survivor) with a colour mode (picker / scrolling rainbow / saturation wash), pulse count, width % and lap seconds; drop the 0.5 cap (global brightness exists). Delete this file.

name: Color Pick Fade
concept: Four evenly spaced soft pulses of one picked colour drift along the strip over black.
visual_verdict: Four dim orange diagonal streaks in the waterfall - smooth mood lighting, very dim because of the 0.5 cap.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with real-unit controls; hue/saturation are sliders rather than a colour picker.
action_notes: Survivor 'Pulse Train': replace hue/sat sliders with an hsvPicker, add a rainbow/wash colour mode (absorbing color-fade-pulse), remove the half-brightness cap, add a 2D radial/axis option.

name: color twinkle bounce
concept: A comb of bright crests ~13 px apart sways back and forth along the strip while the palette drifts; four palette presets.
visual_verdict: Bold candy-coloured zigzag beads sweeping side to side through green, blue, magenta, red, yellow; lively and clean.
perf_smell: none (two sin per pixel)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the idea and improves on it (full brightness, coherent crest hue, palettes).
action_notes: Good as is; optionally a 2D mode where the comb sways along a chosen axis.

name: Color Twinkles
concept: Random-free twinkles: two incommensurate spatial sines phase-modulate each other into a noise-like field carved into sparks by ^4 and a hard floor.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows diagonal streaky moire with rainbow speckle and dark gaps - reads as glitchy stripes rather than twinkles, and dim (0.5 cap).
perf_smell: four sin per pixel (fine)
cleanroom_quality: Header says both 'curated original' and 'clean-room reimplementation' - provenance is muddled.
action_notes: The deterministic sine trick produces visible streaks, not twinkles; the pop-and-fade survivor (or a simplex-noise sparkle mode on it) does the job better. Delete.

name: colourful fireflies
concept: A swarm of per-spark-coloured sparks dart along the strip with comet tails, slow by friction and respawn elsewhere.
visual_verdict: Busy, dense multicolour streaks and stair-stepped tails in the waterfall; energetic but noisy - the per-pixel hue stamp makes tails flicker colour where sparks cross.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount); decay is per frame, not per second (delta*0.1 trim only scales motion)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful fork-of-fireflies port; the original author's own note that the colours do not work well shows.
action_notes: The fireflies family (fireflies, colourful-fireflies, slowflies, xmasflies) should be one pattern with a colour mode (warm white / per-fly rainbow / holiday / picker), speed and trail seconds, rendered with renderBulk fade() + setPixel; delete this file.

name: Comets
concept: Three comets bounce along the strip at staggered rates with feedback() decay and blur1D glow; heads desaturate toward white.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows three crossing rainbow-tinted trajectories, but heads skip pixels each frame so trails read as dashed lines; hue spans only 30% of the wheel.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) buffer; renderBulk fade()+setBlur+setPixel needs none
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Survivor of the multi-comet strip family: renderBulk with fade(), interpolated head deposit (fill the span crossed this frame so trails are continuous), comet count, speed in strips/s, trail seconds, palette; absorbs bulk-comet-trails.

name: Complements 3D
concept: A gradient between a hue and its complement along one axis with a dimmed waist, the pair rotating around the wheel every ~10 s.
visual_verdict: Vertical two-colour gradients (cyan/orange, blue/yellow, magenta/green...) with a dark muddy band in the middle; simple and slow.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the dimmed waist is a workaround for RGB lerp mud that OKLab mixing (mixColors) removes properly.
action_notes: Make 'complement / triad' a colour-pair mode and 'axis' an option of the gradient survivor, blended in OKLab so no dimmed waist is needed; delete this file.

name: Continuous Cellular Automata
concept: A live continuous-valued Wolfram automaton (three-parent average + offset, fractional part) scrolling upward as a spacetime waterfall, with drifting rule, sparks and a convergence watchdog.
technique: cellular automaton ring buffer, per-pixel sample
visual_verdict: A single red seed grows into nested fractal cones that rise and break into a red/olive lattice of arches and voids - genuinely evolving, though chunky at 16 columns and the red-to-olive palette is muddy.
perf_smell: fixed 16x16 view upsampled (blocky on 64x64); per-pixel two-row lerp is fine
cleanroom_quality: Deliberately diverged (live waterfall, watchdog) per review; delivers the automaton idea better than the frozen original.
action_notes: Size COLS/VIEW from gridWidth()/gridHeight() (capped, e.g. 64) so it is native on panels, draw with fillCanvas or paintCanvas from the ring, and use a proper palette (setPalette with a dark-to-bright ramp) instead of hue arcs; consider folding cellular-automata-1d's discrete rules in as a 'binary rule' mode.

name: coolaura
concept: Calm aquatic aura: blue-green pulses swell and spread from random spots over a dim blue ground, with a slow whole-strip breath.
visual_verdict: Index-order render shows a solid bright blue field with soft green bands appearing and fading; on a strip it is a calm blue wash with green swells - pleasant but flat (blue is at full brightness, not 'dim').
perf_smell: each live pulse loops over ALL pixels (pulses x pixelCount per frame) plus an interpreted colorize loop; 2x array(pixelCount)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful behavior; the background blue is far brighter than the spec's calm look implies.
action_notes: Fold in as an 'aqua swell' palette/style of the strip aurora survivor (growing splat per pulse, breath as a global multiplier), with a much dimmer ground; delete this file.

name: Coral Plasma
concept: Glowing ridged-noise filaments wind through a tumbling, breathing 3D sampling volume, cores washing to white.
technique: per-pixel perlinRidge (5 octaves) with per-frame rotation
visual_verdict: On 2D it is uniform cyan/violet salt-and-pepper speckle on black every frame - the filaments are far finer than a pixel, so it reads as TV static.
perf_smell: perlinRidge with 5 octaves per pixel (0.54 ms on 1024 px; ~9 ms on 16384)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec's constants (zoom 1.5-3, 5 octaves, gain 1.3), which produce sub-pixel detail at LED resolution; the 2D/1D wrappers fabricate a z that does not help.
action_notes: Keep the 'glowing veins' idea but at LED scale: zoom out to ~1 feature per 6-8 px, 2 octaves of simplex ridge (abs of simplex3) driven through a palette, sampled on a coarse canvas (fillNoise3D into 32x32 + paintCanvas) so 64x64/128x128 stay cheap.

name: Coronal Ejection 2D
concept: A stylized sun: white-hot noisy core with turbulence arms sheared into a pinwheel, mirror fold option, and periodic prominence eruptions, on a blackbody-ish ramp.
visual_verdict: A glowing core with curling filament arms that drift hue from amber to green over the sheet; organic and alive, but dim and murky at 32x32 - prominences are hard to pick out and the green phase loses the 'sun' read.
perf_smell: perlinTurbulence (3 octaves) + atan2 + hypot per pixel plus an eruption loop: 0.78 ms/frame
cleanroom_quality: n/a (reviewed fork, rebuilt from the polar-noise idea)
action_notes: Merge coronal-mass-ejection into this as a 'stylized pinwheel' toggle (one sun pattern); default hue cycle to 0 so it stays solar (palette via setPalette black-red-orange-white), and evaluate the noise on a polar canvas (e.g. 64 angles x 24 radii via fillNoise3D) sampled per pixel to cut cost on 128x128.
